prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic 9:16 straight-on mirror selfie in a high-end dark marble bathroom at night.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long wavy blonde-highlighted hair, defined brows, full lips, glamorous makeup and natural skin texture, wearing a matching leopard-print strapless corset top and ruched leopard-print mini skirt with a midriff cutout.
prompt.composition_elements: Stand square and centered to the ornate gold-framed mirror, holding a gold smartphone at face level with a subtle natural weight shift. Capture full outfit from mid-thigh to top of head. Preserve the leopard print, corset silhouette, ruched skirt and clear phone reflection.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm recessed ceiling lighting and soft phone-screen glow illuminate the face and reflect off dark brown-black marble, gold fixtures and glass shower enclosure; no harsh shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic 9:16 mirror-selfie photograph, sharp face and outfit detail, clear reflection, editorial fashion quality, realistic marble and fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic straight-on mirror selfie photograph in 9:16 format of one original approved adult woman with long wavy blonde-highlighted hair, defined brows, full lips, glamorous makeup and natural skin texture. She wears a matching leopard-print strapless corset top and ruched leopard-print mini skirt with a midriff cutout. Stand perfectly square and centered to a large ornate gold-framed mirror, holding a gold smartphone straight up at face level with a subtle natural weight shift. Capture the full outfit from mid-thigh to the top of her head, with phone and hand visible in the reflection. Set the scene in a high-end hotel or luxury penthouse bathroom at night with dark brown-black marble walls, glass shower enclosure, gold fixtures and warm recessed ceiling lighting supplemented by a soft phone-screen glow. Use sharp clear reflection, realistic fabric and marble texture, warm golden tones and no harsh shadows.
